styl: Realistic dark-fantasy character portrait, painterly photorealism in the quality of a high-end fantasy book cover or AAA concept art. Half-body, three-quarter view, eye-level, subject centered with headroom, 85mm lens look, shallow depth of field. Dramatic chiaroscuro with warm key light and cool rim light, muted earthy late-medieval palette, highly detailed skin pores, fabric weave, worn leather and metal. Background: softly blurred environment that hints at the character's home. Grounded, believable, not cartoonish, no anime, no text, no letters, no watermark, no frame, no border.

postavy.Postava_Corvin: A human man around forty, leader of a secret resistance in an oppressive theocratic city. He is blind: a dark cloth band tied over his eyes. Fine, slightly elven facial features from distant elven ancestry, narrow face, short dark hair with grey at the temples, calm knowing half-smile. Wears dark studded leather armor under a worn scholar's coat with ink stains, a lute strapped to his back, a slim dagger at his belt, a bundle of forbidden scrolls in one hand. Background: candle-lit hidden cellar library with stacked banned books.
postavy.Postava_Dluben: A Goliath monk of shadow and former sage: very tall, broad-shouldered, grey stone-like skin with darker lithoderm patterns, bald head, calm meditative expression, deep-set eyes. Wears simple dark charcoal monk wraps and a sash, no armor, bare forearms wrapped in cloth, a calligraphy brush and small ink pot tucked into the sash. Wisps of living shadow curl around his hands. Background: dim mountain monastery scriptorium with hanging scroll calligraphy and moonlight.
postavy.Postava_Kazi: Kazim, a small halfling smuggler and jungle guide: about one meter tall, wiry and agile, sun-tanned skin, mischievous ever-present grin, curious bright eyes, hair in many thin braids decorated with colorful feathers. Wears patched studded leather armor with countless pockets bulging with trinkets and 'found' objects, a shortbow on his back, a shortsword and dagger at the hip, a coil of rope. Background: dark, dense, steaming primeval jungle with giant roots and hanging vines.
postavy.Postava_Vaelen: Vaelen, a tall human inquisitor-paladin of a ruthless theocratic order, about thirty-five: cold handsome face, close-cropped neat hair, clean-shaven, piercing judgmental gaze, impeccably groomed. Wears polished full plate armor with a white tabard, carries a kite shield emblazoned with a single stylized watching eye (the sigil of the Order), a longsword at his side. Background: grey stone city street with smoke from a book burning, banners of the eye.
postavy.Postava_Antemius: Antemius, Lord of Dreams and Fear, a dark god: a tall humanoid figure formed of swirling freezing mist and jagged ice, features only half-solid and shifting like a nightmare, two eyes like cold distant white-blue stars. Frost crystals and shadowy dream-shapes of fearful things drift around him. Majestic, terrifying, otherworldly. Background: a frozen fortress hall in the far north under an aurora, blizzard.
postavy.Postava_Corthrin: Corthrin, a divine priestess, Mother of the Builder gods: a tall serene woman made of soft radiant light and flowing woven cloth, her face always partly veiled so it is never fully visible, only a gentle mouth and glowing silhouette. Robes of intricate woven knots, hands raised in blessing, healing golden light. Background: an ancient ruined temple with tapestry knots carved into stone pillars, shafts of light.
postavy.Postava_Eligon: Eligon, Father of Humans and bringer of luck, a giant golden-haired warrior god: towering, muscular, noble bearded face with kind but stern eyes, long golden hair. Wears radiant ornate golden full plate armor, a holy greatsword glowing faintly, and a harvest sickle hanging at his belt. Background: endless golden southern wheat fields at sunset, a distant temple.
postavy.Postava_Ertin: Ertin, an ancient destroyed father god: a colossal stone giant the size of a mountain, body of cracked star-flecked dark stone with glittering mineral veins, moss and small trees on his shoulders, two eyes blazing like two suns, a greatsword of starlight. Shown from the chest up looming over a forest, tiny birds for scale. Background: a western forest and stormy sky.
postavy.Postava_Ertus: Ertus the Stained, creator of the world, a dead god seen as an echo: a gentle-looking man in simple flowing robes, long unkempt hair, tired kind eyes, his hands and forearms stained with swirling luminous paint in the colors of entire worlds — oceans, forests, sunsets. Slightly translucent, ghostly, as a memory. Background: a vast dark primordial ocean with a newly painted continent rising.
postavy.Postava_Irtis: Irtis the Fiery, Mother of Dwarves, sand and seas, a draconic sorceress goddess: a woman whose body seems made of glowing red-hot sand and molten glass, faint red dragon scales on her cheekbones and shoulders, eyes of fire, long hair made of white sea foam that streams like waves. Flames curl from her palms. Background: desert ruins and pyramids at night with a stormy sea beyond.
postavy.Postava_Tirent: Tirent the Wise, creator of elves and horses: an ancient tall elf with silver hair and a long silver beard, deep wise eyes, simple grey-green robes, holding up an old iron lantern in which a tiny star burns brightly, illuminating his face. A ghostly white horse stands behind him. Background: a deep old eastern forest at night with giant trees.
postavy.Postava_Zaira: Zaira, patron goddess of life, harvest and sun: a radiant woman with skin the color of ripe wheat, warm golden eyes, hair made of living green and autumn leaves with small flowers, wearing a gown of woven leaves. Grass and wildflowers bloom around her bare feet, warm sunlight. Background: fertile southern farmlands and an orchard under bright sun.
postavy.Postava_Breffan: Breffan, an archmage ruler: a gaunt, emaciated tiefling man in his fifties with yuan-ti serpent blood, small swept-back horns, greenish scales on his neck and jawline, golden slit-pupil snake eyes, thin cruel lips. Wears a dark green high-collared robe with serpentine embroidery, holds a quarterstaff, a familiar snake coiled on his shoulder, arcane diagrams glowing faintly. Background: a forbidden arcane laboratory with jars and astronomical instruments.
postavy.Postava_Forpa_VII: Forpa VII, a puppet king around fifty: greying hair and beard, tired anxious eyes, sagging cheeks of a man who lost weight; wears heavy rich brocade royal robes over plate armor, a crown, and many jeweled rings that are visibly too loose on his thin fingers. A cleric of the Order with the eye sigil whispers in the shadows behind him. Background: a gloomy throne hall with banners of a watching eye.
postavy.Postava_Iridin_III: Iridin III, a rural king and ranger: a lean, sinewy human man around forty-five with a weathered sun-beaten face, short beard, sharp hunter's eyes. Wears a plain practical coat over a breastplate, a longbow slung over his shoulder even on the throne, a shortsword, a simple circlet. Background: a modest wooden-hall throne room open to hills and farm fields.
postavy.Postava_Istuvion: Istuvion, a forest giant-king and druid of firbolg lineage: a huge gentle goliath with bluish-grey skin, a long beard full of living moss, antlers of wood grown into his wooden crown, calm deep eyes. Wears armor of bark and hide, holds a greatclub glowing with green druidic magic. Background: a sacred old-growth forest with sun shafts, deer in the distance.
postavy.Postava_Mi_Komde: Mi-Komde, a small priestess-queen of wood elf and satyr blood: petite, olive skin, pointed ears, kind eyes, curly dark hair crowned with a wreath of wheat ears, gold hoop earrings, small curved goat horns, and goat legs with hooves. Wears earthy studded leather and a light priestly shawl with sun symbols, holds a wooden staff, soft smoke of incense and honey jars. Background: a sunlit temple courtyard among wheat fields.
postavy.Postava_Oltar: Oltar, a tribal barbarian chieftain: a big burly human man, wild dark hair and braided beard, a scar across the bridge of his nose, booming laugh mid-expression, bare muscular chest with tribal paint under a full bear pelt draped over his shoulders, a greataxe resting on one shoulder, handaxes at his belt. Background: a wild northern camp with bonfires and hide tents.
postavy.Postava_Otec_Samuel: Father Samuel, the Grand Inquisitor and ruler of a theocracy: a thin, gaunt man in his sixties with greyish ashen skin, eyes completely black like ink, thin lips, bald or close-shaven head. Wears an immaculate white monastic cassock over plate armor, a heavy mace, a pendant with a stylized watching eye. Unsettling quiet menace, as if whispering. Background: a cathedral interior with burning books on a pyre and cold light.
postavy.Postava_Pertham: Pertham, the Primate of a free city and a scholar-cleric: an old human man in his seventies, spectacles with lenses of clear mountain crystal, white wispy hair, ink-stained fingers, attentive kind but strict face. Wears a cleric's habit with many pockets stuffed with scrolls over half-plate armor, holds a mace and an open book. Background: a great library in a city built near ancient ruins.
postavy.Postava_Szkunzi: Aettar Szkunzi, warlord of clan lands: an enormous goliath over two and a half meters tall, grey skin covered with stone-like markings and patterns, bald head, fierce stern face, massive muscles, unarmored chest with clan trophies, a gigantic greataxe named 'Mountain' strapped on his back. Background: a windswept eastern coastal town with longhouses and a stormy sea.
postavy.Postava_Timopeus: Timopeus, consul of a merchant free city and spymaster: an elegant slim human man around forty-five, neatly trimmed beard, slicked dark hair, a charming smile that never reaches his cold calculating eyes. Wears dark velvet doublet over shadowy studded leather, several signet rings, a rapier at his hip, a hidden hand crossbow, a faint arcane glow between his fingers. Background: a candle-lit counting house overlooking a harbor at dusk.
postavy.Postava_Veanor_I: Veanor I, king of the western elves: a tall high elf with long white hair woven into a single braid, eyes the color of moss, fine ageless features, proud and defiant. Wears silvery elven studded leather armor with leaf motifs, a rapier with a thorn-shaped crossguard, a longbow on his back, a delicate silver circlet. Background: an elven city of white towers in mountains with small temples.
postavy.Postava_Wort_XXIV: Wort XXIV, a dwarf duke and battle master: a very broad dwarf with a steel-grey beard braided into six thick braids with metal rings, stern tired eyes, heavy brow. Wears runic plate armor with glowing engraved runes, a warhammer in his hand, a heavy crossbow on his back. Background: a carved mountain hall with forges and ancient symbols of a fire goddess hidden in the stone.
postavy.Postava_Yuthika: Yuthika, queen of the free southern islands and a pirate: a confident tiefling woman around thirty with deep red skin, curved horns decorated with gold rings and chains, golden eyes, long black hair, a sly smile. Wears a pirate captain's long coat over studded leather, a protective cloak, a rapier and a scimitar at her hips. Background: a tropical harbor with sailing ships at sunset.
postavy.Postava_Mirta_Velska: A lean human woman pirate captain around thirty-five, weathered sun-browned skin, sharp hawkish face, dark hair in a long braid threaded with dried reeds, a thin scar across her chin, confident sly smile. Wears dark studded leather armor over a faded green sailor's shirt, a long patched coat, a rapier in her hand and a hand crossbow on her belt. Background: misty reed islands of a vast lake with a half-sunken stone tower and a long ancient bridge on the horizon.
postavy.Postava_Hrouda: A stocky broad dwarf bosun, ruddy face, huge braided red-brown beard tied with rope knots, bald tattooed head, gruff frown. Wears a tarred leather jerkin, carries a round wooden shield and a coiled leather whip, a weighted fishing net over his shoulder. Background: a pirate raft among tall lake reeds in fog.
postavy.Postava_Ondra_Sumec: A big young human man harpooner with long drooping catfish-like moustache, shaggy black hair, bare muscular arms with fish-scale tattoos. Wears a simple leather vest and fisherman's trousers, holds a long barbed spear like a harpoon, bundle of javelins on his back. Background: a narrow flat boat on a misty lake with reeds.
postavy.Postava_Lin_Uhor: A slim halfling woman diver and thief, wet slicked-back black hair, sleek dark-grey eel-skin wetsuit-like leathers, two daggers on her thighs, a small pouch of stolen rings, mischievous cold eyes, water dripping. Background: underwater-lit ruins of a drowned tower beneath a lake surface, reeds above.
postavy.Postava_Babka_Mlzena: An old human hedge witch druid, hunched and wiry, wrinkled face, cloudy grey eyes, long white hair woven with reeds and small fish bones, a shawl of grey wool and moss. Holds a gnarled reed-and-driftwood staff with a small glowing flame floating above her palm. Background: fog rolling over a reed island at dawn.
postavy.Postava_Saffi_Ambrova: A tiefling woman pirate captain around forty, deep red skin, swept-back curved horns ringed with gold bands, amber eyes, elegant and dangerous, a sprig of pomegranate blossom pinned to her coat. Wears a polished steel breastplate over a crimson brocade coat with a tricorn-less captain's sash, holds a rapier in a duelist stance. Background: deck of a sailing ship off a lush green coast with golden wheat fields and a sun temple in the distance.
postavy.Postava_Orvo_Tesak: A huge orc first mate, grey-green skin, prominent tusks, one tusk capped in brass, shaved head with a top-knot, battle scars, wild grin. Bare chest with crude sailor tattoos, leather harness, holds a massive greataxe. Background: storm-lashed ship deck with ropes and sails.
postavy.Postava_Nema_Solna: A young human sorceress of draconic blue lineage, pale skin with faint blue scale patterns on cheekbones and neck, crackling electric blue eyes, white salt-crusted hair blown by wind, wears a sea-blue weathered robe with brass buttons. Small lightning arcs between her fingers. Background: dark sea under thunderclouds seen from a ship's bow.
postavy.Postava_Pip_Skorapka: A small halfling man scout, freckled, curly sandy hair, a turtle-shell pauldron and a bandana, quick nervous grin, holding a loaded hand crossbow, a shortsword at his hip, a spyglass on a cord. Background: a ship's crow's nest high above a sunny turquoise sea and green coast.
postavy.Postava_Kharr: A bronze dragonborn bosun, metallic bronze scales, frilled crest, calm stern golden eyes, wears chain shirt under a sea-worn tabard, holds a spear and a round iron-rimmed shield, faint lightning in his nostrils. Background: ship deck with coiled ropes, golden sunset sea.
postavy.Postava_Bartolomej_Kroupa: A charismatic plump human pirate captain and bard around fifty, ruddy cheeks, big curled grey moustache, laughing eyes, feathered wide hat, chain shirt under a wine-stained flamboyant coat, a rapier in one hand and a battered mandolin on his back, a white ferret perched on his shoulder. Background: smugglers' sea cave with tidal pools, lanterns and barrels.
postavy.Postava_Palenka_Sroubkova: A small rock gnome woman bombardier and wizard, wild singed orange hair, soot-smudged face, brass goggles on her forehead, leather apron full of tools and corked clay flasks of alchemist's fire, holding a small flaming bomb and a spellbook strapped to her hip. Background: cluttered ship's gun deck with powder kegs and lanterns.
postavy.Postava_Hromotluk: A towering goliath monk brawler, grey stone-like skin with darker patterns, bald, broken nose, calm half-smile, bare muscular torso with wrapped fists and a sailor's sash, no weapons. Background: rowdy harbor tavern brawl with overturned tables, warm lamplight.
postavy.Postava_Ilien_Vresova: A slender wood elf woman ranger and sharpshooter, olive skin, long ash-brown hair with small heather sprigs, green hooded cloak, dark leather armor, holding a longbow with an arrow nocked, quiver on back. Background: shadowy coastal cliffs above a sea cave at dusk.
postavy.Postava_Matka_Kotlina: A sturdy middle-aged dwarf woman cleric and ship's cook-medic, rosy cheeks, thick grey braids pinned up, kind but fierce eyes, apron over chain mail, a mace on her belt, a hidden pendant of an anvil wreathed in flame and sea foam glowing softly in her hand. Background: ship's galley with copper pots and a stove fire.
postavy.Postava_Vorek_Hald: A grim old dwarf gate warden, iron-grey beard in heavy braids, deep tired eyes, scarred face, heavy splint armor with a black tabard bearing a silver tower with a closed gate, a large shield and a warhammer. Background: massive closed iron gates of a dark mountain fortress city with a tall tower, shadows moving on the walls, twilight.
postavy.Postava_Edrik_Popelny: A pale gaunt human city guard warlock around thirty, ash-grey skin, sunken eyes glowing faint ember red, short black hair, black tabard with a silver tower, a longsword wreathed in dark smoke and embers, chain shirt. Background: dark battlements of a mountain fortress city with a chasm and red glow beneath.
postavy.Postava_Morn: A silent human guard and assassin wearing a smooth featureless black iron mask with narrow eye slits, hooded black cloak over studded leather, black tabard with a silver tower, a heavy crossbow in his hands and a shortsword. Background: misty high wall walk of a closed mountain fortress city at night.

styl_karta: Collectible fantasy character art card, vertical, in an Art Nouveau illustrated style: detailed ink linework with fine cross-hatching, rich muted watercolor-like colouring, realistic proportions and a realistic face (an illustrated, not photographic, look), in the quality of a premium limited-edition art print. Layout, which must be identical on every card: an off-white cream paper margin around a rounded-rectangle card with a shiny metallic GOLD FOIL Art Nouveau frame of thin double lines and elegant curling vines and leaves. Behind the character's head and shoulders is a large circular halo medallion with a stained-glass geometric flower and rosette pattern framed by thin gold rings. The character stands three-quarter length, centered, slightly overlapping the medallion and the frame, holding their signature weapon or item, with their home environment painted around and behind them inside the frame. At the bottom there is an ornate gold filigree scroll cartouche containing the name in elegant gold serif capitals, exactly: "{NAME}". There is no other text anywhere: no copyright line, no numbers, no signature, no watermark. Keep the character's face, species, hair, costume and equipment exactly as in the reference portrait.
karta_pouziti: Prompt = styl_karta s {NAME} z jmena_karet + 'Character: ' + postavy[stem] + harmonizace s domovinou; vstupní obrázky: dosavadní portrét postavy + vzorová karta (secesní zlatý rám). Výstup 1024x1536.
styl_karta_bozstvo: EPIC divine variant of a collectible fantasy art card, vertical. Keep the same card family as the reference card: Art Nouveau illustration with detailed ink linework, fine cross-hatching and rich watercolor-like colouring, a cream paper margin, an ornate metallic frame with curling filigree, a large circular stained-glass halo medallion behind the figure, and an ornate scroll cartouche at the bottom with the name in elegant serif capitals, exactly: "{NAME}". Make it more epic and monumental than a mortal's card: the deity is larger than life and seen from a slightly low heroic angle, divine light rays burst from the medallion, and the figure breaks out of the frame (hands, robes or effects overlap the frame and margin). The frame itself is themed to this god as described below and is more elaborate than a mortal card, with small symbolic emblems at the four corners. No other text anywhere: no copyright, no numbers, no signature, no watermark. Keep the deity's face, body, costume and attributes as in the reference card.

temata_bozstev.Postava_Antemius: Theme: Lord of Dreams and Fear. The frame is silver and pale frost-blue metal grown with jagged ice crystals and thorny nightmare tendrils; the corner emblems are closed and open eyes. The medallion is a deep midnight rose window of shattered ice glass with a starfield and an aurora, and two cold star-eyes at its centre. Drifting shadow dream-shapes of fearful creatures and a swirling blizzard. Palette: ink black, ice blue, violet aurora, silver.
temata_bozstev.Postava_Corthrin: Theme: Mother of the Builders, priestess of life. The frame is white-gold woven in endless interlaced knotwork, like threads of a sacred tapestry; the corner emblems are knot rosettes. The medallion is a radiant mandala of woven light threads. Soft golden healing light pours from her raised hands, and her veiled face glows. Palette: ivory, pale gold, warm white, soft rose.
temata_bozstev.Postava_Eligon: Theme: Father of Humans, bringer of luck. The frame is radiant burnished gold with wheat sheaves, oak leaves and sun rays; the corner emblems are four-leaf clovers and lucky coins. The medallion is a blazing sunburst rose window. His holy greatsword shines, golden wheat fields sway at sunset, and a heroic triumphant aura surrounds him. Palette: gold, amber, warm white, deep sky blue.
temata_bozstev.Postava_Ertin: Theme: ancient destroyed father god, a colossal stone giant. The frame is dark weathered stone and old bronze, cracked and broken in places, with glittering star-flecked mineral veins; the corner emblems are twin suns. The medallion is a shattered stone ring with two blazing suns behind his head. He is mountain-sized, towering over a forest with tiny birds and clouds around his shoulders, and his starlight greatsword gleams. Palette: basalt grey, bronze, sun gold, storm blue. Tragic grandeur.
temata_bozstev.Postava_Ertus: Theme: Ertus the Stained, the dead creator who painted the world. The frame is made of flowing luminous wet paint and brush strokes swirling in every colour of the world, oceans, forests and sunsets, set against tarnished gold; the corner emblems are brushes and palettes. The medallion is a cosmic painted globe of the newly created world. He is slightly translucent and ghostly, his stained hands trailing glowing paint that becomes the continent rising from a dark primordial ocean. Palette: deep indigo with vivid rainbow paint accents and tarnished gold.
temata_bozstev.Postava_Irtis: Theme: Irtis the Fiery, Mother of Dwarves, of sand and of seas, a draconic goddess. The frame is red gold and molten glass with dragon scales, licking flames on one side and curling sea-foam waves on the other; the corner emblems are anvils and small dragon heads. The medallion is a rose window of fire and waves around a dragon eye. Flames curl from her palms, her sea-foam hair streams like breaking waves, and desert pyramids stand under a stormy night sea. Palette: crimson, molten orange, sand gold, sea teal.
temata_bozstev.Postava_Tirent: Theme: Tirent the Wise, creator of elves and horses, lord of the Eastern Forest. The frame is silver entwined with living ancient wood, ivy and leaves, with running horses carved in relief; the corner emblems are lanterns and horse heads. The medallion is a night-sky rose window of constellations radiating from the star in his lantern. A ghostly white horse rears behind him, giant old trees stand at night, and starlight falls on his face. Palette: silver, moss green, midnight blue, starlight white.
temata_bozstev.Postava_Zaira: Theme: patron of life, harvest and sun. The frame is warm gold overgrown with blooming flowers, wheat ears, vines, fruit and leaves; the corner emblems are suns and pomegranates. The medallion is a sun-and-flower rose window glowing like noon. Flowers and grass burst into bloom around her, butterflies and golden pollen drift, and a fertile orchard lies under bright sun. Palette: wheat gold, leaf green, poppy red, sky blue.

karta_bozstvo_pouziti: Božstva: styl_karta_bozstvo s {NAME} + temata_bozstev[stem] + ' Deity description: ' + postavy[stem]; vstupní obrázky: karta postavy ve stylu styl_karta + vzorová karta. Výstup 1024x1536.
